ruleset.name: Exalted Versus World of Darkness
ruleset.edition: Exalted vs World of Darkness (Revised), a fan crossover running Exalted-style Chosen on the World of Darkness 20th-anniversary Storyteller chassis.
ruleset.license: Original mechanics references only; no verbatim text from the ExvWoD document, Exalted, or any World of Darkness corebook is reproduced. Exalted and its Charm/Caste names belong to Onyx Path Publishing; World of Darkness clan/Discipline/sect names belong to Paradox Interactive AB. Distributed in the spirit of the Dark Pack Agreement (worldofdarkness.com/dark-pack). This is unofficial, non-commercial, fan-made material and is NOT official World of Darkness or Exalted material.
ruleset.summary: Storyteller-system d10 dice pool on the V20 baseline. Pool = Attribute + Ability. Each die at or above the chosen difficulty (default 6, range 6-9, capped at 9) is one success. A 1 subtracts one success EXCEPT on a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, where 1s do not subtract. Botch only on zero successes AND at least one 1. 10s count as one success unless a Charm says otherwise. Power runs on a single fungible Essence/mote pool spent on Charms; no blood, no Humanity, no Frenzy. Intimacies anchor the character and resist supernatural compulsion (Willpower vs 8).

resolution.poolFormula: Attribute + Ability (+ specialty +1, + Charm dice). On a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, 1s do not subtract successes.

Trivial.description: Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.

Standard.description: ExvWoD / V20 default. Average task under normal conditions.

Challenging.description: Pushes a competent character; pressure or distraction.

Difficult.description: Few mortals succeed without supernatural aid.

Nigh-Impossible.description: Heroic. Difficulty never exceeds 9 in ExvWoD, regardless of modifiers.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Raw muscle. Lifting, melee damage, brawling pools.

attributes.name: Dexterity
attributes.description: Agility, hand-eye coordination, attack accuracy, dodging.

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Endurance, soak (Exalts soak all damage types), resisting fatigue.

attributes.name: Charisma
attributes.description: Force of personality, sincere charm, leadership presence.

attributes.name: Manipulation
attributes.description: Deceit, guile, indirect influence, getting others to act against their interest.

attributes.name: Appearance
attributes.description: Beauty / presence; affects attraction, allure, first-impression rolls.

attributes.name: Perception
attributes.description: Spotting, hearing, noticing details and changes in environment.

attributes.name: Wits
attributes.description: Reaction speed, on-the-fly thinking, initiative component.

skills.name: Alertness

skills.name: Subterfuge

skills.name: Animal Ken

skills.name: Drive

derivedStats.name: Motes
derivedStats.formula: The single fungible Essence pool (called the Essence Pool in the rules; named Motes here so it is not confused with the Essence rating). Charms and committed artifacts spend from this one pool. Its maximum is set by the 'Mote Pool' stat.

derivedStats.name: Permanent Willpower
derivedStats.formula: The character's permanent Willpower rating, 1-10 (all Exalted begin at 5). This is the CAP on the Willpower pool shown in the Resources cluster. Adjust this stepper directly — raise it as the character spends XP. Temporary Willpower refreshes to this rating on a full rest; regain 1 (once per session) for strongly affirming an Intimacy.

derivedStats.name: Mote Pool
derivedStats.formula: The maximum size of the Motes (Essence) pool. It depends on BOTH Exalt type and Essence rating, so there is no single formula — set this stepper from the table in the 'Rule: Essence Pools (per Exalt type)' lorebook entry. Solars/Abyssals/Infernals: E1=10, E2=12, E3=15, E4=17, E5=20. Lunars/Sidereals/Alchemicals: E1=8, E2=10, E3=12, E4=14, E5=15. Dragon-Blooded: E1=5, E2=6, E3=7, E4=8, E5=10. Liminals: E1=6, E2=8, E3=10, E4=11, E5=12. Raise it when your Essence rating goes up. The Motes bar in the Resources cluster uses this as its cap.

derivedStats.name: Health Track
derivedStats.formula: 7 levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0) / Hurt(-1) / Injured(-1) / Wounded(-2) / Maimed(-2) / Crippled(-5) / Incapacitated. Penalty in effect = the highest filled box. Bashing/Lethal/Aggravated tracked separately. Charms (Ox-Body Technique, Flesh-aspect levels, Mutations) ADD levels at runtime via the track's 'Add level' buttons.

damageTypes.label: B
damageTypes.description: Blunt or non-lethal. Exalts soak with Stamina + armour at difficulty 6. Heals in ~30 minutes per level.

damageTypes.label: L
damageTypes.description: Edged, piercing, gunfire. Exalts soak with Stamina + armour at difficulty 6 (mortals need armour). Heals in ~30 minutes per level (1 hour for Maimed/Crippled).

damageTypes.label: A
damageTypes.description: Fire, sunlight (to vulnerable types), supernatural claws, divine effects. Exalts may still soak it (Stamina + armour, difficulty 6). Heals slowest; Incapacitated aggravated takes ~12 hours.

derivedStats.name: Join Battle
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Wits + 1d10 each combat. Act highest to lowest; ties to highest Dexterity + Wits. Wound penalty subtracts from the rating, not the d10.

derivedStats.name: Melee Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Melee. Armed close-combat attack pool (blades, clubs, daiklaves). Charms and weapons modify it.

derivedStats.name: Ranged Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Firearms. Ranged attack pool (range modifiers add difficulty: +1 medium, +2 long). Charms and weapons modify it.

derivedStats.name: Unarmed Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Brawl. Unarmed attack pool (punches, grapples, claw strikes). Charms modify it.

derivedStats.name: Soak
derivedStats.formula: Stamina + armour soak dice, rolled at difficulty 6. Exalts soak ALL THREE damage types (bashing, lethal, AND aggravated) with the same Stamina + armour pool — unlike most WoD creatures, who cannot soak lethal/aggravated without armour. Optional rule: if the Storyteller uses Dangerous Aggravated, aggravated soak is difficulty 8 instead of 6. Soak rolls cannot botch.

derivedStats.name: Parry
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Melee (or Dexterity + Brawl unarmed). Defence pool versus close attacks. Charms and weapons modify it.

derivedStats.name: Evade
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Athletics. Defence pool to avoid an attack entirely. ExvWoD has no Dodge Ability — Athletics covers evasion.

derivedStats.name: Limit / Alienation
derivedStats.formula: 0-10. Liminals track Alienation here (gained from botches, betraying Nature/Intimacy, horror reactions, harming the lifeline; at 10 = Alienation state). Other Exalt types with a Great-Curse-style Flaw (Solar Intemperate, Lunar Bestial Fury, Dragon-Blooded Driven by the Elements, Infernal Thrall of the Wyrm, Sidereal Brittle Reality) track their Limit here. Most characters leave this at 0.

values.label: Dormant
values.description: No outward flare. The spiritual aura is invisible; the Caste mark is dormant. Use when the Exalt has spent fewer than 3 Essence this scene, or is a non-Exalt.

values.label: Glimmering
values.description: 1-2 Essence spent this scene. Faint shimmer; the Caste mark glints when Essence is spent but the banner is not yet alight.

values.label: Bonfire
values.trigger: 3+ points of Essence spent in a single scene.
values.description: Anima banner becomes visible — in the depleted World of Darkness it rises only a few feet, bright as a burning bonfire, in the colour/texture of the Exalt's brand. The Caste mark involuntarily blazes on the forehead (Dragon-Blooded show Aspect markings / elemental flux instead; Fire Aspects deal 2 lethal/turn to adjacent beings, others 1 lethal/turn). Fades (Essence rating x 3) minutes after the Exalt stops spending Essence.

values.label: Iconic
values.description: Sustained bonfire or specific Charm triggers. The banner takes on the Exalt's full totemic / divine spirit-shape. Unmistakable; everyone present knows a great power walks among them.

values.label: Ancient Sorcerer
values.description: Has the Hedge Magic / Ancient Sorcery training (Occult 3+, plus a mentor, grimoire, or Brigid's Heir). Spells are cast as extended Wits + Occult rolls (difficulty 7-9) with an Essence cost and ritual time.

resources.label: Motes (Essence pool; cap = Mote Pool stat)

lorebook.name: Exalted vs World of Darkness Reference
lorebook.description: Keyword-triggered reference for Exalted Versus World of Darkness (Revised): modified V20 dice mechanics, Essence/mote economy, Charms, anima, Intimacies, and per-Exalt-type overviews. Original mechanics references only; Exalted and World of Darkness names belong to Onyx Path Publishing and Paradox Interactive AB. Unofficial fan material.

entries.name: Rule: Dice-pool resolution
entries.content:
**Rule: Dice-pool resolution.** ExvWoD = modified V20 Storyteller system.
- Pool = (Attribute + Ability) + specialty (+1 die in scope) + Charm dice.
- Each die ≥ chosen difficulty = 1 success. Default difficulty 6 (range 6–9).
- ≥1 net success = action works.
- 10 = 1 success unless a Charm or anima power explicitly doubles it.
- Difficulty caps at 9 — modifiers can't push higher.
- Flashy/dramatic descriptions never raise difficulty for Exalts (see Stunts) and never grant bonus dice.

entries.name: Rule: The Rule of One & Caste Abilities
entries.content:
**Rule: The Rule of One & Caste Abilities.**
- Default: each 1 rolled subtracts 1 success.
- Exception — 1s do NOT subtract on:
  - Caste Ability rolls (Solars / Abyssals / Sidereals)
  - Aspect Ability rolls (Dragon-Blooded)
  - Key Ability rolls (Infernals)
  - For Lunars / Alchemicals / Liminals: the relevant Caste/Aspect Attribute, not Ability
- 1s can still cause a botch if the roll has zero net successes.
- This is the signature reliability of an Exalt within her sphere of mastery.

entries.name: Rule: Botch
entries.content:
**Rule: Botch.**
- Botch = zero net successes AND ≥1 die showing a 1.
- A roll where 1s cancelled all successes (but nothing else went wrong) is a plain failure, NOT a botch — regardless of how many 1s.
- On a botch the Storyteller introduces a real complication, not just a miss.

entries.name: Rule: Difficulty ladder
entries.content:
**Rule: Difficulty ladder.**
- 4 = trivial (often waived)
- 5 = routine
- 6 = standard (default)
- 7 = challenging
- 8 = difficult — few mortals without supernatural aid
- 9 = nigh-impossible
- Capped at 9 — penalties past 9 instead raise required successes or are narrated as elevated stakes.

entries.name: Rule: Specialties
entries.content:
**Rule: Specialties.**
- A specialty = narrow focus within an Attribute or Ability (e.g. Melee: Daiklave; Occult: Spirits).
- When the action falls in scope: +1 flat die to the pool.
- ExvWoD does NOT use the oWoD 10-again specialty reroll. Just a flat bonus die.

entries.name: Rule: Willpower
entries.content:
**Rule: Willpower.**
- Rating 1–10. Permanent rating + temporary pool (≤ permanent).
- Spend 1 to: resist mental/emotional compulsion · power some Charms · REFUSE acting against an Intimacy (Willpower vs difficulty 8 — see Intimacies).
- Substitutes for any WoD trait an Exalt lacks (Rage, Self-Control, Gnosis, Spite) when a crossover power demands it.
- Refresh: temporary → permanent on a full rest. +1 once per session for strongly affirming an Intimacy.

entries.name: Rule: Health track & Exalted healing
entries.content:
**Rule: Health track & Exalted healing.**
- 7 levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0) / Hurt(-1) / Injured(-1) / Wounded(-2) / Maimed(-2) / Crippled(-5) / Incapacitated.
- Penalty of the highest filled box applies to ALL dice pools.
- Damage types: Bashing, Lethal, Aggravated — tracked separately.
- Exalted heal fast: ~30 min per level for Bruised–Wounded; 1 hr for Maimed/Crippled; 12 hr for Incapacitated aggravated. No scarring or permanent crippling short of full amputation.
- Ox-Body Technique / Lunar-Liminal Flesh-aspect levels / Mutations ADD permanent health levels. Player uses the Health Track's '-0/-1/-2' Add-level buttons; this is NOT a damage delta.

entries.name: Rule: Soak & Damage Types
entries.content:
**Rule: Soak & Damage Types.**
- Exalted soak Bashing, Lethal, AND Aggravated — Stamina + armour dice, difficulty 6.
- Each soak success cancels one damage die. Soak rolls cannot botch.
- Mortals: cannot soak Lethal or Aggravated without armour. Never soak those with Stamina.
- Optional Dangerous-Aggravated rule: aggravated soak is difficulty 8 instead.
- Exalts may parry ranged attacks (including bullets) when capable.
- Cold iron and silver do NOT bypass Exalt defences. Fire / sunlight only deal aggravated to types with specific vulnerability (e.g. Sun-Seared Flaw).

entries.name: Rule: Combat round
entries.content:
**Rule: Combat round.**
- Initiative = Dexterity + Wits + 1d10. Act high to low; ties to highest Dex+Wits. Wound penalty hits the rating, not the d10.
- No advance declaration, no abort rules, no multiple-opponent penalty.
- Multiple actions: declare the total; first action −1 die / +1 difficulty, each further action −1/+1 more; ≤1 attack per multi-action set; stop if difficulty would exceed 9.
- Extra actions (Celerity-style Charms) use full pool, may include several attacks, resolve at end of turn in initiative order.
- Attack pools: Brawl = Dex+Brawl · Melee = Dex+Melee · Firearms = Dex+Firearms (range +1/+2 difficulty for medium/long) · Thrown = Dex+Athletics.

entries.name: Rule: Essence Pools (per Exalt type)
entries.content:
**Rule: Essence Pools (per Exalt type).**
- ExvWoD uses ONE fungible mote pool (the Essence Pool). Personal and Peripheral are NOT separated.
- Set the Mote Pool stat from the table below for your Exalt type + Essence rating. Per-turn spend cap is the second number.
- Solar / Abyssal / Infernal: E1 pool=10 turn=1 · E2 12/2 · E3 15/3 · E4 17/4 · E5 20/5
- Lunar / Sidereal / Alchemical: E1 8/1 · E2 10/2 · E3 12/3 · E4 14/3 · E5 15/4
- Dragon-Blooded: E1 5/1 · E2 6/1 · E3 7/2 · E4 8/2 · E5 10/3
- Liminal: E1 6/1 · E2 8/2 · E3 10/2 · E4 11/3 · E5 12/3
- Essence rating max = 5. Charms costing more than the per-turn cap take consecutive turns to channel.

entries.name: Rule: Regaining Essence
entries.content:
**Rule: Regaining Essence.**
- Sunrise/Sunset grant — (3 + Essence rating) motes:
  - Sunrise: Solars · Infernals · Alchemicals · Dragon-Blooded
  - Sunset: Abyssals · Lunars · Sidereals · Liminals
  - (no need to see the sky)
- Starting a scene at 0 motes → gain 1.
- Dragon Nest: 1 mote per 15 minutes inside.
- Caste/Aspect once-per-scene method: 2 motes (specific triggering condition per type).
- Spirit World: 1 per 3 hours (not Liminals).
- Dreaming: 1 per 6 hours (all).
- Underworld: 1 per 3 hours (Abyssals & Liminals only).
- Dragon-Blooded only: 1 hour daily meditation in Aspect-appropriate place → 2 motes.

entries.name: Rule: Anima Banner & Caste Marks
entries.content:
**Rule: Anima Banner & Caste Marks.**
- Spending 3+ motes in a single scene → banner visible.
- Visible only a few feet above the head in the depleted WoD, bright as a bonfire, in the Exalt's characteristic colour. Caste mark involuntarily blazes on the forehead.
- Fades (Essence × 3) minutes after she stops actively spending.
- Unmistakable tell that a great supernatural power is present (though only the wisest spirits recognise WHAT).
- Dragon-Blooded: no Caste mark — manifest Aspect markings + destructive elemental anima flux. While flaring, everything within ~1 yard takes 1 lethal/turn (2 for Fire Aspects).
- The Anima Control Merit grants control over flaring.

entries.name: Rule: Intimacies
entries.content:
**Rule: Intimacies.**
- An Intimacy is either a personal tie ('My sister (love)', 'Prince Vitel (hatred)') OR a statement of philosophy ('Power demands restraint').
- DEFENCE: when something tries to force the character to act against / abandon / betray an Intimacy, the player may roll Willpower vs difficulty 8 to refuse. Works as a SECOND line of defence even after failing to resist a compulsion power (e.g. Dominate).
- WILLPOWER REGAIN: strongly affirming an Intimacy through action → +1 Willpower, once per session.
- Intimacies REPLACE WoD Humanity/Virtues. ExvWoD has NO Frenzy and NO blood/Hunger.

entries.name: Rule: Stunts (flashy action)
entries.content:
**Rule: Stunts (flashy action).**
- For an Exalt, dramatic/stylish/extravagant action carries NO mechanical penalty and does NOT raise difficulty: 'kick a guy' and 'swing around a lamppost and kick a guy in the face' have the SAME difficulty.
- Grants NO bonus dice — reward is in the story, not the pool.
- Applies only to Exalted. Mortals, vampires, werewolves etc. still face standard difficulty modifiers for ambitious actions.
- Affects the action's DIFFICULTY, not its outcome — spectacle never makes success harder, but it doesn't guarantee success either.
- This is NOT the Exalted-3e dice-bonus tier system. Do not award stunt dice or stunt Willpower.

entries.name: Rule: Ancient Sorcery
entries.content:
**Rule: Ancient Sorcery.**
- Lost spellcraft of the Age of Legends. Requires Occult 3+ and a source — mentor, grimoire, or the Brigid's Heir Merit (once/story).
- Learning: 10 XP per spell (5 freebie points at chargen).
- Casting: usually extended Wits + Occult vs difficulty 7–9, plus an Essence cost and ritual time. Some spells require sacrifice, components, or specific locations.
- Alchemicals and Liminals generally cannot learn it. Dragon Kings only at Essence 5.

entries.name: Rule: Backgrounds
entries.content:
**Rule: Backgrounds.**
- Rating 0–5. Buy more dots in play: current rating × 2 XP per new dot.
- Standard WoD Backgrounds available: Allies, Contacts, Resources, Influence, Fame, Mentor, Retainers, etc.
- ExvWoD-specific:
  - **Dragon Nest** — secure Essence-rich haven. Dots = infiltration difficulty for outsiders.
  - **Past Lives** — once/session add rating to an appropriate ancient-Ability roll (Solars, Lunars, Abyssals, Infernals, Dragon Kings).
  - **Supernatural Status** — standing in a WoD faction; Acknowledged → Revered.
- Type-specific examples: Heart's Blood (Lunar additional forms), Arcane (Sidereal stealth-of-identity), Whispers / Spectre Notoriety (Abyssal), Demonic Guide (Infernal), Primium Countermeasures (Alchemical), Dragon-Touched / Jade Talisman (Dragon-Blooded).

entries.name: Rule: Merits & Flaws
entries.content:
**Rule: Merits & Flaws.**
- Up to 7 points each (cannot take Merits/Flaws targeting other supernatural types).
- Notable Exalted Merits: **Anima Control** (1/2/5pt — banner-flare control) · Priest · Brigid's Heir · Hedge Magic · Exalted Kinfolk / Kinain · Perfection of the Grave (Abyssal) · Drifting Moon Aptitude (Lunar).
- Notable Flaws: Beacon of Power (flare at 2 motes/scene) · **Sun-Seared** (sunlight burns Abyssals/Infernals/Liminals) · Permanent Caste Mark · Casteless (Lunar) · Aspect of the Corpse (Abyssal).
- Great-Curse Flaws (track on the Limit/Alienation stat): Solar Intemperate · Lunar Bestial Fury · Dragon-Blooded Driven by the Elements · Infernal Thrall of the Wyrm · Sidereal Brittle Reality.

entries.name: Rule: Cross-Game Reconciliation
entries.content:
**Rule: Cross-Game Reconciliation.**
- The WoD games were not built for crossover. Substitute Willpower for any trait an Exalt lacks (Rage / Self-Control / Gnosis / Spite).
- For powers calibrated by power level, Exalts always fall in 'supernatural target' (NOT 'mortal').
- Absolute effect vs absolute defence: defence wins. Two absolutes with no clear defence → contested Willpower roll.
- Power equivalence (Celestial Exalted): E1/2/3/4/5 ~ Vampire Generation 8/7/6/5/4 · Werewolf Rank 2/3/4/5/6 · Mage Arete 2/4/6/8/10.
- Power equivalence (Terrestrial / Liminal): one tier lower across the board (Generation 11/10/9/8/7).
- Essence conversion when an Exalt shares Essence with others:
  - 1 Essence = 2 Quintessence / 2 Glamour / 2 Conviction / 1 Pathos
  - 1 Essence = 3 Faith / 3 Chi / 3 Sekhem
  - Cannot convert to: vampire Blood · werewolf Rage · werewolf Gnosis

entries.name: Rule: Character creation (ExvWoD)
entries.content:
**Rule: Character creation (ExvWoD).**
- **Attributes**: 7/5/3 priority allocation across Physical / Social / Mental. All start at 1; no Attribute >5 without freebie spend.
- **Abilities**: same priority pattern; Lunars / Alchemicals / Liminals key off Caste/Aspect Attributes instead of Abilities.
- **Essence rating**: 1 for all new Exalts.
- **Mote Pool**: set per type + Essence (see Essence Pools entry). E1 = 10 (Solar/Abyssal/Infernal) / 8 (Lunar/Sidereal/Alchemical) / 5 (Dragon-Blooded) / 6 (Liminal).
- **Willpower**: all new Exalts begin at 5.
- **Intimacies**: ~3 at chargen. Mandatory 4th for Lunars ('I will never wear chains') and Liminals ('I will drive the Unquiet away from the living').
- **Backgrounds**: 5 dots distributed (1 freebie/dot at chargen; raise in play at current rating × 2 XP).
- **Merits & Flaws**: up to 7 points each. Flaws return up to 7 freebie points.
- **Charm dots at creation** (most go to Caste/Aspect/Key):
  - Solar: 7 dots total, ≥5 from Caste
  - Lunar: 6 total, ≥3 from Caste
  - Dragon-Blooded: 5 total, ≥3 from Aspect
  - Sidereal: 6 total, ≥4 from Caste (+ free 'Auspicious Prospects')
  - Abyssal: 7 total, ≥5 from Caste
  - Infernal: 7 total, ≥5 from Key Charm categories
  - Alchemical: 6 Charms in Charm Array slots
  - Liminal: 6 total, ≥3 from Aspect
- **Freebie points**: 15 base, +up to 7 from Flaws. Costs: Attribute 5/dot · Ability 2/dot · Background 1/dot · Charm rating × 3 · Gnosis n/a (Essence rating × 7) · Willpower 1/dot · Specialties 1/each.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Solar
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Solar.** The returned legends of sun, law, and heroic perfection.
- **Castes** (8 Caste Abilities each, get the 1s-don't-subtract benefit): Dawn (war) · Zenith (priest/leader) · Twilight (savant/sorcerer) · Night (spy/assassin) · Eclipse (diplomat/oath-binder).
- Celestial Essence pool: E1=10 → E5=20.
- **Anima**: distinct per Caste. Caste mark blazes when flaring.
- **Once/scene Essence renewal**: triggers per Caste (defeating a supernatural foe, sanctifying an oath, etc.).
- **Supernal Charms**: at Essence 2+ (first from Caste, second from any) — granted enhancements beyond normal Charm text.
- Charms organised by Ability. Power equivalence ~ Vampire Generation 8 → 4 across Essence 1–5.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Lunar
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Lunar.** Wild shapeshifters of survival and freedom.
- **Castes**: Full Moon (warrior — Physical) · Changing Moon (trickster/social — Social) · No Moon (shaman/sorcerer — Mental).
- Key off Caste ATTRIBUTES (not Abilities) for the 1s-don't-subtract benefit.
- Pool: E1=8 → E5=15.
- **Shapeshifting**: gain forms by hunting/killing an animal or from a spirit. Totem form free, rage form for combat. Heart's Blood Background = extra forms.
- Silver Marks of Luna protect against unwilling transformation.
- **Mandatory 4th Intimacy**: 'I will never wear chains.'
- Regain Essence at sunset.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Dragon-Blooded
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Dragon-Blooded.** Terrestrial Exalted — most numerous, only ones native to the World of Darkness.
- **Aspects** (8 Aspect Abilities each, 1s-don't-subtract): Air · Earth · Fire · Water · Wood.
- Smallest pools of any Exalt type: E1=5, E2=6, E3=7, E4=8, E5=10.
- No Caste mark. Aspect markings + destructive anima FLUX: while flaring, all within ~1 yard take 1 lethal/turn (Fire: 2).
- Aspect affinity: once/scene, native-Aspect Charm cost reduced by 1 (min 0).
- Regain Essence at sunrise OR via 1-hour daily Aspect-appropriate meditation (2 motes).

entries.name: Exalt Type: Sidereal
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Sidereal.** Hidden fate-weavers.
- **Castes** (8 Caste Abilities each, 1s-don't-subtract): Chosen of Journeys · Serenity · Battles · Secrets · Endings.
- Pool: E1=8 → E5=15. Regain at sunset.
- **Lesser Sign** anima powers — scene-long benefit while flaring.
- **Dynamic LARPing**: spend 1 Willpower to wear a false destiny and pass as a mortal archetype. Other Sidereals always see through.
- **Greater Signs** at Essence 4+: cost PERMANENT Willpower; catastrophic effects.
- **Arcane Background** (2 free dots; +2 Stealth, −2 to identify/track; caps Fame).
- Cannot take Destiny Background or Dark Fate.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Abyssal
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Abyssal.** Chosen of death and the Neverborn — dark mirrors of Solars.
- **Castes** (8 Caste Abilities each, 1s-don't-subtract): Dusk · Midnight · Daybreak · Day · Moonshadow.
- Solar-tier pool (E1=10 → E5=20) but regain at SUNSET. Less Essence from many once-per-scene triggers than Solars.
- **Power in the Blood**: manifest fangs; drink blood to restore Essence.
- **Shadows of Death**: pick 2 cosmetic death-omens. Local Shroud drops by Essence rating in their vicinity.
- **Trappings of the Grave**: without death symbolism, +1 difficulty to all living-world actions.
- **Nameless Curse**: cannot speak true name, increase living population, or save living lives.
- **Apocalyptic Charms** at Essence 2+/4+.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Infernal
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Infernal.** Demon-princes of Hell.
- No Castes. **7 Crowns** (set anima power): Eyes · Flames · Glory · Kings · Night · Worlds · Wrath.
- Solar-tier pool (E1=10 → E5=20). Regain at sunrise and by satisfying an Urge once/scene (+2 motes).
- Choose **8 Key Abilities** (function as Caste Abilities — 1s don't subtract) and **2 Key Charm categories** (XP discount).
- **Shintai** (demon form) unlocks at Essence 2+ (cost 2 motes + 2 Willpower first time; escalating Essence rolls after). Replaces the health track with its own; grants Demonic Aspects.
- Charm categories: General · Kakuri · Lanka · Skinned Alive · Wicked City · Hells.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Alchemical
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Alchemical.** Living machine-Exalted built by a Sublime Artificer — not born (appendix type).
- **Castes**: Orichalcum · Moonsilver · Jade · Starmetal · Soulsteel. Each has 3 Caste Attributes (1s-don't-subtract).
- Lunar-tier pool (E1=8 → E5=15). Regain at sunrise and by expressing Caste nature once/scene.
- **No anima banner flare** — instead a Caste Attribute bonus while powered.
- **Charm Array**: reconfigurable slots (7 at E1, +2 per Essence). All Charms cost the favoured rate.
- Reconfigure during Dormancy (Willpower roll, 6 hours).
- **Primium Countermeasures** Background grants innate countermagick vs mages.
- Cannot learn Ancient Sorcery.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Liminal
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Liminal.** Living corpses reassembled by a mortal's intense passion (appendix type).
- **Aspects**: Blood · Breath · Flesh · Marrow · Soil.
- Pick 3 Aspect Attributes (1s-don't-subtract; matching Charms are favoured).
- Smallest-but-one pool: E1=6 → E5=12. Regain at sunset.
- **Aspect markings** manifest voluntarily or on anima flare (Appearance 0 socially; witnesses roll Willpower vs 8 or recoil).
- **Alienation track** (0–10 on Limit/Alienation stat). Rises from botches, betrayals, witnessed horror, harming the lifeline. At 10 = Alienation state.
- **The Lifeline**: mandatory Intimacy bond to creator. Without lifeline, Liminal cannot regain Willpower from sleep.
- **Undying**: resurrect on an Essence roll unless brain destroyed.
- **Mandatory 4th Intimacy**: 'I will drive the Unquiet away from the living.'
- Cannot take Totem Background.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Dragon Kings
entries.content:
**Exalt Type: Dragon Kings.** Ancient reptilian sapients of the Hollow Earth — NOT Exalted (no Charms, no anima, no Caste mark).
- **Breeds**: Raptok · Anklok · Pterok · Mosok.
- Dragon-Blooded-tier pool (E1=5 → E5=10). Respire (2 + Essence) motes at sunrise.
- Instead of Charms: **Paths of Prehuman Mastery** (10 paths, rated 1–5, purchased in ascending order like Disciplines).
- Essence rating caps both maximum Intelligence AND maximum Path rating. PCs start at Essence 2.
- Breed Attributes/Abilities (3 each) immune to 1s.
- Cannot soak aggravated or parry ranged attacks without Path abilities.
- Ancient Sorcery only at Essence 5+.

entries.name: Derived stat: Motes
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Motes — formula: The single fungible Essence pool (called the Essence Pool in the rules; named Motes here so it is not confused with the Essence rating). Charms and committed artifacts spend from this one pool. Its maximum is set by the 'Mote Pool' stat.

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Willpower
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Permanent Willpower — formula: The character's permanent Willpower rating, 1-10 (all Exalted begin at 5). This is the CAP on the Willpower pool shown in the Resources cluster. Adjust this stepper directly — raise it as the character spends XP. Temporary Willpower refreshes to this rating on a full rest; regain 1 (once per session) for strongly affirming an Intimacy.

entries.name: Derived stat: Mote Pool
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Mote Pool — formula: The maximum size of the Motes (Essence) pool. It depends on BOTH Exalt type and Essence rating, so there is no single formula — set this stepper from the table in the 'Rule: Essence Pools (per Exalt type)' lorebook entry. Solars/Abyssals/Infernals: E1=10, E2=12, E3=15, E4=17, E5=20. Lunars/Sidereals/Alchemicals: E1=8, E2=10, E3=12, E4=14, E5=15. Dragon-Blooded: E1=5, E2=6, E3=7, E4=8, E5=10. Liminals: E1=6, E2=8, E3=10, E4=11, E5=12. Raise it when your Essence rating goes up. The Motes bar in the Resources cluster uses this as its cap.

entries.name: Derived stat: Health Track
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Health Track — formula: 7 levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0) / Hurt(-1) / Injured(-1) / Wounded(-2) / Maimed(-2) / Crippled(-5) / Incapacitated. Penalty in effect = the highest filled box. Bashing/Lethal/Aggravated tracked separately. Charms (Ox-Body Technique, Flesh-aspect levels, Mutations) ADD levels at runtime via the track's 'Add level' buttons.

entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Join Battle — formula: {Dexterity} + {Wits}

entries.name: Derived stat: Limit / Alienation

Liminals track Alienation here (gained from botches, betraying Nature/Intimacy, horror reactions, harming the lifeline; at 10 = Alienation state). Other Exalt types with a Great-Curse-style Flaw (Solar Intemperate, Lunar Bestial Fury, Dragon-Blooded Driven by the Elements, Infernal Thrall of the Wyrm, Sidereal Brittle Reality) track their Limit here. Most characters leave this at 0.

entries.name: Difficulty ladder reference
entries.content:
Exalted Versus World of Darkness difficulty ladder. Threshold values needed for success:
- Trivial (threshold 4) — Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.
- Routine (threshold 5) — Routine task; minor pressure.
- Standard (threshold 6) — ExvWoD / V20 default. Average task under normal conditions.
- Challenging (threshold 7) — Pushes a competent character; pressure or distraction.
- Difficult (threshold 8) — Few mortals succeed without supernatural aid.
- Nigh-Impossible (threshold 9) — Heroic. Difficulty never exceeds 9 in ExvWoD, regardless of modifiers.

# Exalted Versus World of Darkness — canonical reference

Storyteller-system d10 dice pool on the V20 baseline. Pool = Attribute + Ability. Each die at or above the chosen difficulty (default 6, range 6-9, capped at 9) is one success. A 1 subtracts one success EXCEPT on a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, where 1s do not subtract. Botch only on zero successes AND at least one 1. 10s count as one success unless a Charm says otherwise. Power runs on a single fungible Essence/mote pool spent on Charms; no blood, no Humanity, no Frenzy. Intimacies anchor the character and resist supernatural compulsion (Willpower vs 8).

## Dice
- Type: `d10`
- Notation: `Xd10 vs <difficulty>`

## Resolution
- Mode: `dice-pool`
- Pool formula: Attribute + Ability (+ specialty +1, + Charm dice). On a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, 1s do not subtract successes.
- Default target: 6

## Difficulty ladder
- **Trivial** (threshold 4) — Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.
- **Routine** (threshold 5) — Routine task; minor pressure.
- **Standard** (threshold 6) — ExvWoD / V20 default. Average task under normal conditions.
- **Challenging** (threshold 7) — Pushes a competent character; pressure or distraction.
- **Difficult** (threshold 8) — Few mortals succeed without supernatural aid.
- **Nigh-Impossible** (threshold 9) — Heroic. Difficulty never exceeds 9 in ExvWoD, regardless of modifiers.

## Attributes
- **Strength** (STR) [Physical] — Raw muscle. Lifting, melee damage, brawling pools.
- **Dexterity** (DEX) [Physical] — Agility, hand-eye coordination, attack accuracy, dodging.
- **Stamina** (STA) [Physical] — Endurance, soak (Exalts soak all damage types), resisting fatigue.
- **Charisma** (CHA) [Social] — Force of personality, sincere charm, leadership presence.
- **Manipulation** (MAN) [Social] — Deceit, guile, indirect influence, getting others to act against their interest.
- **Appearance** (APP) [Social] — Beauty / presence; affects attraction, allure, first-impression rolls.
- **Perception** (PER) [Mental] — Spotting, hearing, noticing details and changes in environment.
- **Intelligence** (INT) [Mental] — Reasoning, learning, recall, abstract analysis.
- **Wits** (WIT) [Mental] — Reaction speed, on-the-fly thinking, initiative component.

## Skills
- **Alertness** — Talent. Notice danger and details. Usable untrained at +1 difficulty.
- **Athletics** — Talent. Climbing, running, jumping, swimming, dodging. Usable untrained at +1 difficulty.
- **Awareness** — Talent (ExvWoD). Sensitivity to uncanny phenomena — noticing ghosts gathering, Essence disturbances, supernatural presence. Usable untrained at +1 difficulty.

- **Drive** — Skill. Operate vehicles under stress. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Etiquette** — Skill. Manners, protocol, the unwritten rules of mortal and supernatural society. Untrained: cannot roll.
